notes: Each tool below maps 1:1 to a backend endpoint. 'elevenlabs_config' is what gets entered in the ElevenLabs dashboard when adding a custom tool (webhook type). 'backend_endpoint' is what Claude Code must implement to match exactly. Base URL during local dev will be an ngrok URL; document that in backend/README.md.

tools.name: check_known_incidents
tools.description: Check whether there is a currently known/active IT incident matching the employee's reported issue category. Call this before proposing any troubleshooting steps.

parameters.name: issue_category
parameters.description: One of: vpn, mfa, wifi, password, software_install, other

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Brief free-text description of what the employee reported

response_example_known_issue.workaround: Close the VPN client fully, generate a fresh code manually in the authenticator app, then reopen the VPN client and enter it manually.
response_example_known_issue.affects: MFA push delivery for VPN login

tools.name: create_incident
tools.description: Create a support incident/ticket. Only call this after the employee has explicitly confirmed they want a ticket created. On success this also triggers a Slack notification to the IT support channel as part of the same call.

parameters.name: issue_category
parameters.description: One of: vpn, mfa, wifi, password, software_install, other

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: One of: P1, P2, P3 (P1 = highest)

parameters.name: business_impact
parameters.description: Free text, e.g. 'blocking customer meeting in 30 minutes'

request_body_example.description: VPN authentication failing, workaround attempted but did not resolve
request_body_example.business_impact: Blocking a customer meeting in 30 minutes

backend_endpoint.behavior_notes: If the Slack webhook call fails, still return success:false overall so the agent does not falsely confirm the action. Do not partially succeed silently.

tools.name: notify_support
tools.description: Posts a formatted incident summary to the IT support Slack channel. In the golden path this is called internally by create_incident's handler, not directly by the agent as a separate step — included here as its own endpoint for clarity and in case it's useful to call independently.

elevenlabs_config.note: Not exposed as a separate agent-facing tool in the golden demo path. Backend should still implement it as an internal function/endpoint for modularity.

request_body_example.business_impact: Blocking a customer meeting in 30 minutes
request_body_example.description: VPN authentication failing, workaround attempted but did not resolve
